title: DRTriton: Large-Scale Synthetic Data Driven Reinforcement Learning for Triton Kernel Generation
abstract: arXiv:2603.21465v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Developing efficient CUDA kernels is a fundamental yet challenging task in the generative AI industry. Recent research leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to automatically convert PyTorch reference implementations to CUDA kernels, significantly reducing engineering effort. State-of-the-art LLMs, such as GPT-5.2 and Claude-Sonnet-4.5, still struggle with this task. tldr: 提出DRTriton框架，通过CSP-DAG大规模合成数据、解耦奖励的课程化强化学习以及测试时搜索算法，训练大语言模型将PyTorch程序高效转换为优化的Triton内核。
en_tdlr: DRTriton is a scalable framework that trains LLMs to convert PyTorch programs into highly optimized Triton kernels via CSP-DAG large-scale synthetic data, curriculum RL with decoupled rewards, and test-time search.
